We filled up with gas; the staff was very attentive. We tried to use the restroom, but the staff was cleaning both the men's and women's facilities. It took more than 15 minutes; there were over seven of us, including a child. They closed the doors after cleaning, and we had to wait for everything to dry; we were standing in the sun, and they didn't seem to care at all. Zero consideration; you go there because you need to.
